content: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to hydrocortisone or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. Rarely, prolonged use of corticosteroid medications can impair your body’s ability to respond to physical stress. Although unlikely, this medication may temporarily slow a child’s growth if used for an extended period. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when absolutely necessary. It should not be used for long durations or in large amounts. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone overdoses on this medication and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as cortisol levels, may be conducted while you are using this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and lab appointments. This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. Do not use it later for another condition unless directed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember unless it is almost time for the next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not refrigerate it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This medication is used to treat minor pain, itching, swelling, and discomfort caused by hemorrhoids and other anal area problems, such as anal fissures or itching. To apply this product inside the anus, use the applicator tip, cap, or nozzle as directed in the product package or by your doctor. Fill the applicator with medication from the container as instructed. Insert the applicator about 5 centimeters into the anus and apply the medication in and around the anal opening as directed. Do not use your finger to apply this medication inside the anus. Do not cover the treated area with plastic or waterproof bandages unless directed by your doctor, as this may increase the absorption of the medication through the skin. Wash your hands immediately after use. Avoid getting the product in your eyes, nose, ears, or mouth. This product is typically used 2 to 4 times daily, or after each bowel movement, or as directed by your doctor. The dosage is based on your medical condition and response to treatment. Use this medication regularly to gain the most benefit from it. Do not use more of this product, use it more frequently, or continue using it longer than prescribed by your doctor. If you have been using this medication for a long time or in high doses, do not stop using it suddenly without your doctor’s approval, as some conditions may worsen when this drug is abruptly stopped. Side effects such as redness, burning, or itching at the application site may occur. If your doctor has directed you to use this medication, remember that they have judged the benefit to you to be greater than the risk of side effects. Rarely, this medication may be absorbed into the bloodstream, leading to side effects of excessive corticosteroid exposure. These side effects are more likely in children and individuals who use this medication for a prolonged period. A very serious allergic reaction to this drug is rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
